mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pisces_experiment_report_snapshot (experiment_id, snapshot_version, conclusion_status, primary_metric_key, best_performing_group, winning_variant, analysis_ready, has_srm, breached_guardrails_json, decision_context_json, report_json, generated_by, generated_at) VALUES (#{entity.experimentId}, #{entity.snapshotVersion}, #{entity.conclusionStatus}, #{entity.primaryMetricKey}, #{entity.bestPerformingGroup}, #{entity.winningVariant}, #{entity.analysisReady}, #{entity.hasSrm}, #{entity.breachedGuardrailsJson}, #{entity.decisionContextJson}, #{entity.reportJson}, #{entity.generatedBy}, #{entity.generatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, experiment_id, snapshot_version, conclusion_status, primary_metric_key, best_performing_group, winning_variant, analysis_ready, has_srm, breached_guardrails_json, decision_context_json, report_json, generated_by, generated_at, created_at FROM pisces_experiment_report_snapshot WHERE experiment_id = #{experimentId} ORDER BY snapshot_version DESC
